decisions.reason: GA4 is now Google's only analytics standard, so the plugin is central to the firm's announced analytics-driven, measurable-results positioning and to the development effort it has already sunk, giving no reason to withdraw it.

The retail system interface plugin embodies the firm's claimed interface-development competence and its full-service integration promise, and modest uptake can still be attributed to a normal ramp-up period.

The SEO workshops were only recently launched with their own dedicated web page, a visible public commitment that fits the firm's search-marketing core, so early results are too new to justify dropping them.
